The GEEKOM A5 PRO is a mini PC built around the AMD Ryzen 7530U CPU. It's marketed as a small, affordable, silent machine for office and productivity tasks. So in this video I put it through its paces as a gaming machine and assessed its potential as a low-cost Steam Machine alternative, as you do.

items.title: The $69 PicoIDE Is A Game Changer For Vintage Computing
items.description:
https://www.pcbway.com - PCB fabrication, assembly, 3D printing, CNC machining & more!

The PicoIDE is a brand new IDE optical and hard drive emulator for classic computers. Based on the Raspberry Pi RP2350 and ESP32, it's easy to use, open source, low cost, fully featured, and set to be an absolute game changer for the vintage computing hobby.
